title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: Catalogs renamed in settings, understood everywhere
summary: Completes the catalog work of the last few releases: a catalog renamed in settings.gradle.kts is now understood by hover and Ctrl+click too.

highlights.title: Catalog Renamed In Settings
highlights.description: A catalog renamed with create("deps") kept its file name, so hover and Ctrl+click looked for libs on a project that writes deps and answered nothing, while Find Usages from the toml got it right. Both now read the same rule.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: Gradle lets settings.gradle.kts rename a catalog, with create("deps") { from(files("gradle/libs.versions.toml")) }, so the file keeps its name while build files write deps.retrofit. Find Usages from inside the toml has always read that, but hover and Ctrl+click took the name from the file alone, so they looked for libs on a project that writes deps and answered nothing. The two halves now read the same rule, and the settings files are watched so an edit takes effect right away.
The catalog sweep and the settings sweep are independent and can finish in either order, so the roots of catalogs already read are recomputed when settings arrive rather than being fixed once.

sections.heading: Notes
bullets: A project with no versionCatalogs block in its settings sees no change, verified against a real one.
No new commands or settings in this release.
